decision: The owner chose to announce 1Password login fill on Windows and Linux, which public v1.34.0 already enables (src/main/onepassword-availability.js). It stayed unannounced at release because the Windows and Linux real-account checks ran only in virtual machines, under the waiver of October 12, 2026 in docs/1password-integration.md; the copy stays within that evidence and names the Windows on Arm limit.
claims: docs/website-v1.34-claims.json (onePassword and privacyRevision evidence groups); the homepage copy is in docs/website-cinematic-homepage-claims-v1.34.json.

changes: Heading “1Password login fill on macOS (off by default)” → “1Password login fill (off by default)”
First paragraph: dropped the leading “On macOS,”; the rest is unchanged
Optional 1Password integration: dropped the leading “On macOS,”; the rest is unchanged

legalReview: The owner reviewed and approved the Privacy Policy and Terms changes on October 16, 2026.

supportAnswers.before: Yes, on macOS. Blanc includes an optional integration that fills matching Login items from your installed 1Password desktop app and account when you ask. It is off by default. Windows and Linux do not currently offer this integration.
supportAnswers.after: Yes, on macOS, Windows and Linux. Blanc includes an optional integration that fills matching Login items from your installed 1Password desktop app and account when you ask. It is off by default. It isn’t available on Windows on Arm.

supportAnswers.before: In 1Password Settings → Developer, enable Integrate with other apps under Integrate with the 1Password SDKs. In Blanc, open Settings → Privacy & Security → 1Password, enable Fill logins from 1Password, enter your sign-in email or account ID, and choose Verify. On a login form, press ⌥⌘P (Option + Command + P), or choose View → Fill Login from 1Password. You can also run /1password from the Island.
supportAnswers.after: In 1Password Settings → Developer, enable Integrate with other apps under Integrate with the 1Password SDKs. In Blanc, open Settings → Privacy & Security → 1Password, enable Fill logins from 1Password, enter your sign-in email or account ID, and choose Verify. On a login form, press ⌥⌘P (Option + Command + P) on macOS or Ctrl+Shift+P on Windows and Linux, or choose View → Fill Login from 1Password. You can also run /1password from the Island.

supportAnswers.before: Blanc does not offer a general third-party extension runtime. Ad and tracker blocking is built into the network layer. On macOS, the optional 1Password integration is a narrow, user-invoked bridge to the installed 1Password app, not an extension runtime or a Blanc password store.
supportAnswers.after: Blanc does not offer a general third-party extension runtime. Ad and tracker blocking is built into the network layer. The optional 1Password integration is a narrow, user-invoked bridge to the installed 1Password app, not an extension runtime or a Blanc password store.
